import numpy as np, pandas as pd
exp = pd.read_csv("data/journey_exp.csv")
exp = exp[exp["attn_1"] == 1]                       # 주의 점검 통과자만
m1 = exp["mil"][exp["cond"] == 1].mean()            # 개입 집단
m0 = exp["mil"][exp["cond"] == 0].mean()            # 통제 집단
obs = m1 - m0
print(len(exp), round(m1, 2), round(m0, 2), round(obs, 3))
# 366 5.26 4.98 0.283

rng = np.random.default_rng(73)
diffs = []
for _ in range(5000):
    fake = rng.permutation(exp["cond"].values)          # 딱지만 섞기
    diffs.append(exp["mil"][fake == 1].mean() - exp["mil"][fake == 0].mean())
diffs = np.array(diffs)

one   = (diffs >= obs).mean()                  # 한쪽만 세면
round_ = (np.abs(diffs) >= 0.283).mean()       # 반올림한 값을 문턱에 쓰면
print(round(one, 4), round(round_, 4))
# 0.0182 0.0282

from scipy import stats
rng2 = np.random.default_rng(37)
ps = []
for _ in range(20):
    sub = exp.iloc[rng2.choice(len(exp), size=100, replace=False)]
    a = sub["mil"][sub["cond"] == 1]
    b = sub["mil"][sub["cond"] == 0]
    ps.append(stats.ttest_ind(a, b).pvalue)
ps = np.array(ps)
print(round(ps.min(), 3), round(ps.max(), 3), int((ps < .05).sum()))
# 0.006 0.792 5

t, p_t = stats.ttest_ind(exp["mil"][exp["cond"] == 1],
                         exp["mil"][exp["cond"] == 0])
print(round(t, 2), round(p_t, 4))
# 2.21 0.028

exp2 = exp.assign(high=(exp["mil"] >= exp["mil"].median()).astype(int))
tab = pd.crosstab(exp2["cond"], exp2["high"])
chi2, p_c, dof, _ = stats.chi2_contingency(tab, correction=False)
print(tab.values.tolist(), round(chi2, 2), dof, round(p_c, 3))
# [[98, 85], [83, 100]] 2.46 1 0.117

print(round(obs, 3), round(float(np.mean(np.abs(diffs) >= abs(obs))), 4),
      round(float(diffs.std(ddof=1)), 3))
print(round(float(np.mean(np.abs(diffs) >= 0.1)), 3))   # |차이| 0.1 이상
# 0.283 0.0302 0.13
# 0.444
